NASA Exoplanet Archive (exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu ps / pscomppars): zero-planet control verification & orbital ephemerides (T0, P_orb, e, M_*)
NIST Atomic Spectra Database: 12 vacuum NIR/YJHK Si I, Mg I, K I, Al I, Ca I, Ti I, Na I absorption anchors
